budget_policy: A 128 MiB working-tree review threshold, excluding Git administration. A threshold breach never authorizes deletion of tasks, receipts, configuration or recovery evidence.
scope: Paths are relative to the explicitly selected PRIVATE repository root. Root-level state, digest and run paths cover retained installations; current defaults use the data directory. Unlisted integration artifacts require their producer's review and are not implicitly retained.

artifacts.purpose: Active relay, ingest and command configuration, including private credentials.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Relay delivery, inbound polling and registered commands.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the selected private configuration and validate live credentials separately.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the active configuration and versions needed to interpret unresolved deliveries; retain history in PRIVATE storage.

artifacts.purpose: Routing configuration retained for installed integrations.
artifacts.schema: The installed route consumer owns this schema; this source does not validate its contents.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The installed routing integration and operator recovery.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the approved private version; confirm the consuming integration before changing it.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve until consumer and recovery dependencies have been reviewed.

artifacts.purpose: Durable tasks, alarms, state transitions, deduplication identities and delivery records, including SQLite sidecars.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The stable reminder CLI and scheduled workers.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Use SQLite's backup API or a cold checkpointed snapshot; do not restore a live WAL database by copying only its main file.

retention_rule.rule: Retain current state and required audit history. Remove sidecars only through SQLite or after a verified cold shutdown.

artifacts.purpose: Most recent worker identity and measured delivery receipts.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: A real successful worker delivery regenerates evidence; copied or synthetic receipts cannot establish external readiness.

retention_rule.rule: Retain the latest measured evidence; freshness is evaluated by health, independently of storage retention.

artifacts.purpose: Cursors, inbox projections, reaction identities, durable inbound actions and ingest diagnostics.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Replay-safe inbound delivery and operator diagnosis.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore cursors and durable action records together with the task store; do not reset them as a cache cleanup.

retention_rule.rule: Keep unresolved records, current cursors and deduplication identities. Retire diagnostics only after extracting necessary evidence and proving no active writer or recovery dependency.

artifacts.purpose: Inbound state retained by earlier or explicitly configured installations.
artifacts.schema: The installed ingest consumer; current source formats are documented by scripts/ingest.py and inbound.py.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Installed inbound consumers and migration recovery.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Resolve the installed consumer's state path before restoration or migration; directory age does not establish inactivity.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve active cursors and action identities until migration is verified and replay dependencies are reconciled.

artifacts.purpose: Durable requests, attempt results, event history, process identity and verification evidence for queued work.
artifacts.producer: The work queue and agent worker.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Work recovery, verification and requested final deliverables.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore with the matching task-store state and validate process identity before recovery.

retention_rule.rule: Keep active and unresolved work. Extract selected results before retiring completed development groups; copied source trees and redundant drafts gain no retention exception.

artifacts.purpose: Work records retained by earlier installations or selected with AGENT_CENTER_RUNS.
artifacts.schema: Installed work consumer; current source uses scripts/agent_task.py and agent_run.py.
artifacts.producer: Installed work queue and agent worker.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore alongside the corresponding task-store records after checking the installed run-root selection.

retention_rule.rule: Keep active and unresolved work; review completed groups for dependency-free retirement after preserving selected results.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore approved contributor commands and configuration from PRIVATE history.

retention_rule.rule: Retain the active contributor registry; remove obsolete contributors through reviewed configuration changes.

artifacts.purpose: Contributor registry retained by an installed or explicitly selected digest path.
artifacts.schema: Installed digest consumer; current source accepts AGENT_CENTER_DIGEST.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the approved private registry after checking the installed path selection.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while selected by an installed consumer or needed for migration recovery.

artifacts.purpose: Disposable synthetic database checks created by the explicit verification utility.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: A retained verification result, when requested.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Regenerate with the verification utility in initialized PRIVATE storage.

retention_rule.rule: Remove inactive synthetic workspaces after preserving the selected result; never substitute them for live delivery evidence.

artifacts.purpose: Temporary scripts used to verify an agent result.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Regenerate from the retained attempt verification contract.

retention_rule.rule: Remove only after the verification process has ended and its result is retained.

artifacts.schema: Markdown; links to source-owned deployment and storage contracts.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the current private installation instructions from companion history.

retention_rule.rule: Keep one current setup reference; public source owns generic design and policy.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore reviewed rules; runtime writers reject ignored durable DATA paths.

retention_rule.rule: Keep current tracking rules. Transient locks may be ignored only when their durable owners remain versionable.

artifacts.schema: Text produced by the installed synchronization job.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Future synchronization runs create new diagnostics; preserve unique unresolved failure evidence first.

retention_rule.rule: Review at 1 MiB; retain current diagnostics and unresolved failures, then rotate only after checking the active writer.

artifacts.purpose: Temporary source-integration rollback patches and reconciliation evidence.
artifacts.schema: Git binary patches and their recorded hashes; private maintenance records.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Integration review and rollback until source reconciliation is complete.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Apply the recorded patch only to its documented base after checking its hash and scope.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only while integration or rollback remains unresolved; remove after final verification and explicit maintenance authorization. Do not accumulate a parallel archive of source history.

artifacts.purpose: Temporary holding area for explicitly reviewed inactive development artifacts awaiting authorized removal.
artifacts.schema: Original artifact formats; retain the relocation and inactivity evidence outside the public source tree.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Synthetic tests are regenerated from tools/make_fixtures.py and the source tests. This directory is not a recovery dependency.

retention_rule.rule: Remove after the exact removal action is authorized and inactivity is rechecked. Relocation is not disk reclamation and does not make development outputs core state.
